response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, e.fillcount, o.recordvault FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), g AS (SELECT channel, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) AS order_count FROM j GROUP BY channel) SELECT channel, avg_fillcount, order_count, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS order_fraction FROM g

assumptions.assumption: Executions are linked to orders via an inner join on orderexecutions.ordersmark = orders.recordvault; unlinked executions are excluded. A NULL orderbase forms its own group (GROUP BY keeps NULLs together).
Distinct orders are counted by orders.recordvault (the unique order reference), not by orderspivot. The fraction is each channel's order count divided by the sum of per-channel counts.
